comparator.name: Chemical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The current 2026–2027 Ocasys programme and official bachelor page identify a 180-EC Chemical Engineering bachelor. The formal appendix supplies the complete component structure: a compulsory 60-EC first year, 105 EC of compulsory upper-year courses and 15 EC of approved electives. The official 2026–2027 PDF URL and TER landing label the appendix for 2026–2027, although its repeated page header still says 2025/2026; the current Ocasys curriculum and current programme page corroborate the listed structure and course set. The 15-EC approved-elective space is retained as restricted choice rather than populated with arbitrary selections. The ordinary single bachelor has no named route to select.

exception.reason: The Groningen bachelor is an integrated chemistry-and-process-engineering degree. Its compulsory spine combines organic, inorganic and physical chemistry, spectroscopy and synthesis laboratories with thermodynamics, transport phenomena, reactor engineering, separation processes, process control, process equipment, polymer chemistry and engineering, product technology, numerical analysis, multiple engineering practicals, a 10-EC process-design project and a 15-EC research project. UCR offers useful sustainability, mathematics, programming, data, biology, biochemistry and one life-science laboratory course, but no chemistry sequence and no chemical/process-engineering curriculum. It lacks reactors, separations, process control, thermodynamics, transport engineering, process equipment, polymer engineering, synthesis laboratories and process design. A UCR programme assembled from adjacent science, sustainability and data courses would not be a defensible Chemical Engineering comparator.
exception.curriculumContext: The current 2026–2027 Ocasys programme and official bachelor page confirm the 180-EC degree and current course set. The programme-specific appendix accounts for 60 EC in the compulsory first year, 105 EC in compulsory upper-year courses and 15 EC in approved electives. The PDF’s internal 2025/2026 running header conflicts with its official 2026–2027 URL and landing-page label; this apparent template/header error is disclosed rather than silently ignored, and the live 2026–2027 Ocasys programme is used to establish current applicability.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook rows, including names, descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall 2026 cohort terms. HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry, HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory and the broader life-science cluster provide molecular-biological and laboratory foundations. ENSGATE101 Sustainability Essentials I, ENSGATE201 Sustainability Essentials II, ENSSUST112 Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy, ENSDELT311 R3: Recycling, Recovery, Remediation and ENSSUST311 Renewable System Design address sustainability and systems questions. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming and data-science courses offer quantitative support. BENENTR111 Consumer Product Design provides one general design experience. The workbook contains no general, organic, inorganic or physical chemistry sequence; spectroscopy; chemical thermodynamics; transport phenomena; reactor engineering; separation processes; process control; chemical process equipment; polymer chemistry or engineering; chemical synthesis and analysis laboratory; chemical-engineering practical; or process-design course. The available laboratory and design courses operate in different disciplines and cannot reproduce the cumulative chemical-engineering and industrial-process formation or the 15-EC discipline-specific research project.
